ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio approximately 0.15:1; high-intensity white pixels are sparse and localized against a dominant low-intensity black background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Focal high-intensity mottling on the proximal lower edges of both lobes; distinct circular high-contrast ring-shaped blobs (rosettes) distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces of both dark lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations along the trailing edge with varying pixel-amplitudes; distinct larger indentations/notches on the medial section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve along the trailing edges leading to sharply tapered, upward-sweeping lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular white-on-black ring-shaped pixel formations (barnacle scars) scattered throughout the medial and lateral regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of high-intensity, textured calcified masses (barnacle colonies) adhering to the outer lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific density and spatial arrangement of circular rosette scars across the dark pigmentation provides a highly unique visual fingerprint.
